bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches may enter after search; opaque bags receive extra inspection. The venue also lists backpacks and large purses as prohibited.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Metered street parking and nearby Clay Commons, Brown Hotel and Fifth Street garages are available.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The Mercury Ballroom visitor guide does not specify a dedicated rideshare pickup point.

concessions.summary: The bar offers beer, wine, spirits and nonalcoholic drinks; snacks include popcorn, pretzels and nachos. Outside food and drinks are prohibited.

gates.summary: Doors generally open one hour before showtime. Use a mobile ticket on a phone; if it cannot be displayed, ask for help at the box office with photo ID.
